rights.privacy_note: a public event in the university's main hall, streamed and published by the centre; speakers are named in the announcement, and the audience is visible in wide shots. Nothing from this analysis is published beyond the segment boundaries and the speaker structure.
rights.notes: Programme taken from the event announcement at mishmash.no/events/aulaen2026/. Speaker ids from diarization belong to one run and are renamed by hand after the clustering is checked.

pictures.label: Videogram: every frame squeezed to a column, so the picture becomes a strip
Motiongram: the same strip made from what moved between frames
Colourgram: the dominant colours, minute by minute

curves_empty.why: These came back empty. The reader takes motion vectors from P-frames, and this recording is AV1, which it cannot read. The frame-based quantity of motion is plotted instead, and measures the same thing a different way.
